notes.title: Behind the Scenes: 6 Months of Work, Big Update Ahead
notes.content:
Dear players,

We apologize for the long silence. It's time to share what’s been happening with World of Shooting over the past six months as we move toward full release.

[i]Please note that the following changes are not yet available, but we’ll start rolling out updates to the beta version soon — followed by a release to the main branch.[/i]

🔧 What’s new and improved:

[list]
[*]     We’ve significantly reworked the content and textures for the IPSC levels, including new decorations and visual improvements.
[*]     The Killhouse Campaign is now in its final development stage, with new decorations and improved game balance.
[*]     We’ve redesigned the core gameplay balance — we hope you’ll enjoy the changes!
[*]     Nearly all pistol reload animations have been updated and refined.
[*]     We've added several new weapons to the game. (Yes, we know you love having lots of guns!)
[*]     The game interface now supports 5 additional languages — though we'll definitely need your help polishing the translations.
[/list]

🎉 Also:
The Summer Sale is live — don’t miss the chance to grab select DLCs at a discount!

notes.title: New features and content are available now!
notes.content:
[h1]Dear World of Shooing players, a new update has been released!
What's new in this update?![/h1]

[img]https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2108360/header.jpg?t=1720182128[/img]
[h2]- Killhouse Campaign. [/h2]Pistols, SMG's matches are available right now. Assault rifles, Shotguns, Mixed will be added soon. Killhouse is a paid campaign and you may find corresponding DLC.

[h2]- Weapon paint (Skin creation).[/h2]From now every user may customize the appearance of his weapons. Change color, surface, add stickers. Some stickers and patterns are paid. But basic features are available for free.
[img]https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3064840/header.jpg?t=1719441730[/img]
[h2]- Shooting Range Creator DLC [/h2]- you may still create Shooting ranges for your personal use, but submitting them to the Workshop requires DLC. We just want to prevent a lot of useless content from appearing in the Workshop.
[img]https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3051330/header.jpg?t=1720182208[/img]
[h2]- Skin Creator DLC [/h2]- the same is here to prevent useless content in the Workshop we created such DLC. Also it unlocks some additional content for painting.
[img]https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2948660/header.jpg?t=1720182259[/img]
[h2]- Texture Pack DLC[/h2] - unlocks additional content for painting (skin creation) such as patterns and stickers.

[h2]Other changes:[/h2]
In Practical Shooting stages with bots are rebalanced (rifle stages)
S&W M&P model - new textures and new model
Browning HP - new textures and new model
 
Feel free to discuss new updates, request help or assistance here on Steam or in our [url=https://discord.gg/RzrdakFFWe]Discord channel[/url].

notes.title: New features added!
notes.content:
[i]Features:[/i] two new rules for practical shooting!
1. Users may play without firing positions. These rules give freedom for a shooter to experiment and choose the best strategy! (this feature has been demanded by the community)
2. Open class. Shooters now may use weapons in matches without tiers restrictions (this feature has been demanded by the community)
Options for turning off zoomed target screens and score counters on targets. (Just to make your gameplay more comfortable

[i]Bugfixes:[/i] pump and semi-auto shotguns (with tube magazines) reload speed fix.

notes.title: Small update you should know about!
notes.content:
We just released small update!
1. Upon a lot of user requests we added possibility to buy exp points to the matches. (Anyway you may play without donations it is interesting)
2. Quiz questions - we changed upon user reviews. 1 question will be easy in 90%. Then medium and the difficult.
3. Reloading animation slider - no penalties it will not slow down you. Also if you missed acceleration area you may acelerate another one, so it is not so hardcore now. (we still have small bugs with bolt action rifles and animation slider, we wil fix it ASAP)

Thank you for your support!!!

P.S. We collect crash logs to fix  some crashes users experienced during stages loading.
